$comment: TaskDoor ADR-0014 §2.2, same format as apps/web: the only directions in which one feature may import another, each edge with a reason. scripts/structure-check.mjs rejects every other direction and keeps the edge count from growing; the one cycle (members <-> tasks) is a named exception there (KNOWN_CYCLES).

auth.members: sign-up and onboarding read team invitations and the local team store (team-invitations, team-lifecycle-storage, team-limits)

members.tasks: deleting a team clears its tasks' local state (team-lifecycle-storage: recycle bin, activity, AI drafts, file drafts, collaboration); a known cycle

notifications.members: notifications read the local team store (team-lifecycle-storage)

tasks.ai-connection: task detail and discussion connect an AI tool (AiConnectionDialog, AiConnectionButton)
tasks.me: task tags are picked from the person's tag catalogue (TagPicker)
tasks.members: owners, participants and mentions are picked with MemberSelector / PersonPicker

workspaces.auth: creating a team reuses the onboarding preview (CreateTeamDialog)
workspaces.members: team creation limits and the person picker in the workspace list
workspaces.tasks: the workspace list and directory show tasks (WorkspaceTaskBoard, TaskIcon, task-list-filters, task-time-range)
